protocol.outer_test_policy: Each outer-test fold is evaluated exactly once after training-epoch selection and full outer-train refit.
protocol.epoch_selection: Stratified validation split inside outer-train; selection by validation ROC AUC with validation loss tie-break.
protocol.preprocessing: Per-channel standardization fitted inside selection-train or full outer-train, then applied to validation/test.

interpretation_limits: Internal repeated cross-validation only; no external or prospective validation.
Control status is the HC cohort while patient status is Study1/Study2; disease and study/cohort effects cannot be separated.
Architecture and fixed hyperparameters are a methods-development experiment, not a clinical model.
Attention and community assignments are not causal mechanisms or validated biomarkers.
The shared mask harmonizes the four voxelwise node metrics; FC retains validated original/repair ROI-signal pipelines and was not re-extracted under that mask.
research_notice: Research use only - clinician review required
